انقبضن (form VII)
# اِنْقَبَضْنَ (inqabaḍna) /in.qa.badˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# اِنْقَبِضْنَ (inqabiḍna) /in.qa.bidˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
